reason: A native DeepSeek Harness right-side output workspace for viewing, organizing, and interacting with session-generated files and other supported artifacts.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻右侧产物工作区，用于预览、整理和操作会话生成的报告、文档、图片、PDF 与数据文件。
summaries.en: A native DeepSeek Harness right-side output workspace for previewing, organizing, and interacting with session-generated reports, documents, images, PDFs, and data files.

capabilities: Displays session-linked reports, documents, images, PDFs, and data files in a right-side panel
Reads selected workspace artifacts and supported authorized HTTP(S) files
Renders previews for Markdown, PDF, SVG, images, JSON, CSV, TSV, and text files
Supports copying, downloading, opening containing directories, pinning, hiding, and reordering artifacts
